advent-1.quote: But of this let us take heed, namely, that our soul herself sleep not: for evil is the sleep of the soul.
advent-1.who: St. Augustine, Expositions on the Psalms
advent-1.question: Where has your soul grown drowsy this year? Name one habit of prayer or attention you will wake up to before this week ends.

advent-2.quote: Let no man then of them that live in vice despair; let no man who lives in virtue slumber.
advent-2.who: St. John Chrysostom, Homilies on Matthew
advent-2.question: Are you tempted to drift because life feels easy, or to despair because it feels hard? Choose one concrete way to stay awake today.

advent-3.quote: As we have opportunity, let us help on our salvation, let us get oil for our lamps, let us labor to add to our talent.
advent-3.who: St. John Chrysostom, Homilies on Matthew
advent-3.question: What is the oil your lamp needs: prayer, mercy, patience? Decide today one small act to add to it.

advent-4.quote: Let us then imitate them, and not quench our lamps, but keep them bright by alms-doing, for so is the light of this fire preserved.
advent-4.who: St. John Chrysostom, Homilies on John
advent-4.question: Which almsgiving or kindness keeps your light burning? Choose one person to help this week so your lamp stays bright.

advent-5.quote: Let us sing unto the Lord in our life. Our life at present is only hope; our life will be eternity hereafter
advent-5.who: St. Augustine, Expositions on the Psalms
advent-5.question: Where do you need to hold your hope more loosely than your plans? Name one thing you will wait on God for this Advent.

advent-6.quote: Thou awakest us to delight in Thy praise; for Thou madest us for Thyself, and our heart is restless, until it repose in Thee.
advent-6.question: Which restlessness in you is really a longing for God? Set aside ten quiet minutes today and offer that restlessness to Him.

advent-7.quote: Lo, He hath not yet come: He is in heaven, thou on earth: He delayeth His coming, do not thou delay wisdom.
advent-7.who: St. Augustine, Expositions on the Psalms
advent-7.question: The Lord delays His coming, but not your growth. What one wise decision have you been postponing that you can make today?

advent-8.quote: Thou seest that it is good to make confession. Thou seest that there is salvation for them that repent.
advent-8.who: St. Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lectures
advent-8.question: What sin have you been avoiding naming? Make a confession this week, trusting that salvation, not condemnation, waits on the other side.

advent-9.quote: For man’s confession is man’s lowliness: God’s pity is God’s loftiness. Therefore, since He came to forgive man his sins, let man acknowledge his own lowliness and let God show His pity.
advent-9.question: Where must a mountain of pride be lowered in you? Tell God one thing plainly, and let Him fill the valley with mercy.

advent-10.quote: At the Word and the Voice my thought marvelled:—for lo! John was the Voice;—our Lord was manifested as the Word, that what was hidden should become revealed.
advent-10.who: St. Ephrem the Syrian, Hymns on the Nativity
advent-10.question: John was only a voice pointing to the Word. Whom could you point toward Christ this week, with one honest, humble word?

advent-11.quote: Before the Lord Jesus came, men were glorying of themselves; He came a man, to lessen man’s glory, and to increase the glory of God.
advent-11.question: Where do you still glory in yourself? Choose one accomplishment today and quietly give the credit to God.

advent-12.quote: Forego vengeance, forgive offences: exchange severity for gentleness, indignation for meekness, discord for peace.
advent-12.question: Which rough place between you and another needs smoothing? Make one concrete exchange today: a kind word, a forgiven debt, an apology.

advent-13.quote: Therefore, knowing these things, let us use great diligence, while we are in the threshing floor; for it is possible while we are here, to change even out of chaff into wheat, even as on the other hand many from wheat have become chaff.
advent-13.who: St. John Chrysostom, Homilies on Matthew
advent-13.question: Chaff can become wheat only while we are still on the threshing floor. What one change will you begin today, not later?

advent-14.quote: For it is God’s part to give a contrite and humbled heart, sober, self-possessed, and awestruck, full of repentance and compunction.
advent-14.who: St. John Chrysostom, Homilies on Matthew
advent-14.question: Ask God for a contrite heart rather than manufacturing one. What sorrow, honestly named in prayer today, might He be asking you to hand over?

advent-15.quote: Let the saint exult in that he draws near to victory. Let the sinner be glad in that he is invited to pardon. Let the gentile take courage in that he is called to life.
advent-15.question: Which of the three describes you today: the saint, the sinner, the stranger? Receive that invitation, then share your gladness with one person.

advent-16.quote: Let us not therefore despair, but having so many motives and good hopes, though we sin every day, let us approach Him, entreating, beseeching, asking the forgiveness of our sins.
advent-16.who: St. John Chrysostom, Homilies on Matthew
advent-16.question: What failure keeps you from approaching God? Take it to Him in prayer today, and receive His strength before you try again.

advent-17.quote: She, when the angel entered, was found at home in privacy, without a companion, that no one might interrupt her attention or disturb her; and she did not desire any women as companions, who had the companionship of good thoughts.
advent-17.question: Mary was found in quiet when the angel came. Where will you make room for silence today so that God can find you at home?

advent-18.quote: Of what handmaid? Her who when He was announced as about to be born of her, answered and said, “Behold the handmaid of the Lord: be it unto me according to Thy word.”
advent-18.who: St. Augustine, Expositions on the Psalms
advent-18.question: Mary said yes before she understood. What is one thing God is asking of you that you can agree to today without all the answers?

advent-19.quote: For she became more humble when she knew herself to be chosen of God, and went forthwith to her kinswoman in the hill country, not in order to gain belief by anything external, for she had believed the word of God.
advent-19.question: Mary hurried to serve after being honored. Whom could you go to help this week, setting aside any sense of being special?

advent-20.quote: Magnify Him truly, magnify Him well. Let us praise Him, let us magnify Him who hath wrought the very righteousness which we have; who wrought it in us, Himself.
advent-20.who: St. Augustine, Expositions on the Psalms
advent-20.question: Mary’s praise names God as the doer of good. Write down three good things in you that He worked, and thank Him for each.

advent-21.quote: The day that Gabriel came in unto my low estate, he made me free instead of a handmaid, of a sudden: for I was the handmaid of Thy Divine Nature, and am also the Mother of Thy human Nature, O Lord and Son!
advent-21.who: St. Ephrem the Syrian, Hymns on the Nativity
advent-21.question: God looked on Mary’s lowliness and raised her. What do you consider too small or poor in yourself to offer Him this Advent?

advent-22.quote: When man’s hope had broken down, hope was increased by Thy Birth.
advent-22.who: St. Ephrem the Syrian, Hymns on the Nativity
advent-22.question: Hope breaks down in every life. Where has yours broken, and how will you let the coming of Christ restore it this week?

advent-23.quote: What is so new as to be born of a virgin? Therefore, because there was not in Him what instruction might renew, because He had no sin, there was given Him a new origin of birth.
advent-23.question: Christ comes as a gift, not as an achievement of ours. What do you need to receive from God this week rather than try to earn?

advent-24.quote: I was jealous of Thy Mother, and I thought to put her away, and I knew not that in her womb was hidden a mighty treasure, that should suddenly enrich my poor estate.
advent-24.who: St. Ephrem the Syrian, Hymns on the Nativity
advent-24.question: Joseph misjudged what God was doing. Where might you be misreading a hidden good in your own life? Ask God to show it to you.

advent-25.quote: Again, when thou seest Him lying in a manger, thou wilt not be anxious to put golden garments about thy child, or to cause thy wife’s couch to be inlaid with silver.
advent-25.who: St. John Chrysostom, Homilies on John
advent-25.question: The King chose a manger. What excess in your Christmas preparations can you trim, and give the saving to someone who has little?

advent-26.quote: That unfailing Light, the Light of wisdom, speaking through the cloud of the flesh, says to men, “I am the light of the world; he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.”
advent-26.question: What part of your life still walks in darkness? Bring it to Christ today and follow Him one honest step into the light.

advent-27.quote: We know in what consulship the Virgin Mary brought forth Christ, conceived of the Holy Ghost. Wherefore He, by whom as God the times were made, was made man in time.
advent-27.question: God entered time at the fullness of time. What are you hurrying through, or putting off, that you could live more attentively this very day?

advent-28.quote: First, then, no one ought to be ashamed of becoming poor after being rich, if this happens because he gives freely to the poor; for Christ became poor when He was rich, that through His poverty He might enrich all.
advent-28.who: St. Ambrose, On the Duties of the Clergy
advent-28.question: Christ became poor for you. What generous gift, of money, time or forgiveness, will you give away before Christmas so someone else is enriched?

dec-17.quote: So likewise the Wisdom of God, the Word of God, the Lord Jesus Christ, is everywhere present, because the truth is everywhere, wisdom is everywhere.
dec-17.question: O Wisdom, ordering all things: where in your ordinary day have you overlooked God’s quiet presence? Pause three times today to notice it.

dec-18.quote: For to examine into the testimonies of the Lord, and to seek Him with all the heart, this is to be undefiled in the way, this is to walk in the law of the Lord.
dec-18.who: St. Augustine, Expositions on the Psalms
dec-18.question: O Lord and Lawgiver: which commandment do you treat as a burden rather than a path? Seek Him in it with your whole heart today.

dec-19.quote: For our root is Christ, who hath ascended into heaven. Humbled, he shall be exalted; “he shall spread abroad like a cedar in Libanus.”
dec-19.who: St. Augustine, Expositions on the Psalms
dec-19.question: O Root of Jesse, from whom you draw life: what keeps you from staying rooted in Him? Take one practical step today to be nourished.

dec-20.quote: Blessed be the Merciful One, who saw the weapon by Paradise, that closed the way to the Tree of Life; and came and took a Body which could suffer, that with the Door, that was in His side, He might open the way into Paradise.
dec-20.who: St. Ephrem the Syrian, Hymns on the Nativity
dec-20.question: O Key of David, who opens what no one can shut: which locked door in your life will you ask Him to open today?

dec-21.quote: Thou flashedst, shonest, and scatteredst my blindness. Thou breathedst odours, and I drew in breath and panted for Thee. I tasted, and hunger and thirst. Thou touchedst me, and I burned for Thy peace.
dec-21.question: O Rising Dawn: where has His light scattered your blindness? Name one thing you now see clearly, and thank Him for the light before dark.

dec-22.quote: For the kingdom is the Lord’s, not proud men’s: and He shall rule over the nations.
dec-22.who: St. Augustine, Expositions on the Psalms
dec-22.question: O King of the nations: what part of your life still resists His rule? Give Him that area this evening, and pray for the nations.

dec-23.quote: The Word of God was made flesh by the dispensation of the Virgin, to abolish death and make man live.
dec-23.who: St. Irenaeus, Demonstration of the Apostolic Preaching
dec-23.question: O Emmanuel, God with us in flesh: where do you most need Him near? Speak that need aloud to Him tonight, and trust He has come.

dec-24.quote: There is for all one common measure of joy, because as our Lord the destroyer of sin and death finds none free from charge, so is He come to free us all.
dec-24.question: Tonight the long waiting ends. Who is still outside your joy, unforgiven or forgotten? Reach out to that one person before the feast begins.
